description: Quectel EP06-E / EP06-A / EG06 on USB 2c7c:0306 (LTE Cat 6). Ports by interface: 0 DIAG, 1 GNSS, 2 primary AT, 3 secondary AT/PPP; QMI data function follows, when qmi_wwan is loaded. EP06-E has no GSM radio; legacy QCFG nwscanmode (0 auto, 2 WCDMA, 3 LTE) and QCFG band masks (firmware-dependent); do not use 5G-generation QNWPREFCFG. Never alter QCFG usbnet automatically. On EP06-E/EG06-E raw AT+CUSD was reported to acknowledge without a network reply; MM USSD/firmware variants require separate live verification.

hints.at_source: ModemManager port-type rules for 2c7c:0306, Linux qmi_wwan matching, validated EP06-E live composition: AT on interface 2 and optionally 3; map by USB interface, not changing ttyUSB index
hints.ussd_source: EP06-E/EG06-E raw AT+CUSD acknowledgement without useful network reply; do not treat command OK as network delivery

sms.owner: modemmanager first when MM owns the modem; native only under a leased AT port
sms.send: PDU/UCS2 for Cyrillic and multipart; wait for CMGS prompt and +CMGS confirmation; ambiguous timeouts must not blindly resend
sms.storage: Avoid AT CPMS access during MM probe; distinguish SM/ME/MT, archive before purging, handle segmented messages

cell_lock.write_policy: Never write unless matching query returned a supported response, ownership exclusive and rollback recorded; common/4g cell uses mode 1, common/lte cell uses mode 2; unlock uses mode 0. In ModemManager ownership this is not currently exposed.

telemetry.serving: AT+QENG="servingcell": serving LTE PCI EARFCN TAC RSRP RSRQ RSSI SINR; SINR is already dB
telemetry.ca: AT+QCAINFO: PCC/SCC EARFCN band bandwidth PCI state; SCC state 1 inactive 2 active
telemetry.neighbours: AT+QENG="neighbourcell": LTE intra rows EARFCN PCI RSRQ RSRP RSSI (RSRQ before RSRP); drop invalid/truncated rows
telemetry.antenna: AT+QRSRP: PRX DRX RX2 RX3; EP06 two receive chains; -140/-32768 sentinel, never infer disconnected antenna
telemetry.temperature: AT+QTEMP: 3 or 4 signed sensor values; report maximum valid sensor reading
telemetry.operator: AT+QSPN: prefer SPN with nonnumeric fallback; network operator and SIM operator remain distinct

native_qmi.ownership: exclusive: release ModemManager before uqmi; never run direct QMI concurrently with MM
native_qmi.fallback: restore previous ModemManager interface if bring-up fails

radio.source: EP06-E hardware-specific QCFG/QENG/QCAINFO/QNWLOCK/QRSRP/QTEMP observations; per-firmware feature detection mandatory; docs/modem-zoo/modems/quectel-lte-ec25-ep06-em12.md
